//: Type-checks the tests, which the build config deliberately excludes from dist.
This is NOT optional bookkeeping: golden fixtures live under test/, and without
this config a float assigned to a Minor field in a fixture compiles and passes,
which would void the branded-money guarantee in exactly the files written to
`types: [node]` appears HERE and never in tsconfig.json. The fixture harness has
to read files off disk; the engine must not be able to. tsconfig.json keeps
types: [] and is the config `pnpm build` runs, so `process` in src/ is still a
build error — this file only relaxes it for the pass that checks test/.
rootDir is relaxed to the package root ONLY because this config emits nothing.
